note: First Iraqi Bank's fees and charges for 2026: its current and savings accounts cost nothing to open, keep or close; it charges for reactivating a dormant account and for certified statements, which the game doesn't count. Read again 2026-11-03 and not reached: curl (a "Checking your browser" JavaScript check, 403, not got past), Common Crawl's indexes (CC-MAIN-2026-43: no capture of the address; CC-MAIN-2026-39: no capture of the address) and the Wayback Machine (its CDX answered with a reset connection); the figures stand on the read dated in the source.
